parameter.desc: Engine Speed (read; 0x11EE38: FFF8CD54 x 25 >> 5 (u16) = rpm x 4)

parameter.desc: Coolant Temperature (read; 0x11F250: FFF8CD65 (degC + 50) - 10, floored at 0)

parameter.name: Intake Air Temperature
parameter.desc: Intake Air Temperature (read; 0x11F098: FFF8CEE5 (the OBD IAT source, degC + 50) - 10, floored at 0)

parameter.name: Ignition Timing
parameter.desc: Ignition Timing (read; 0x11E728: final timing FFF8A744 + 128 (0.5 degree units))

parameter.name: Mass Airflow
parameter.desc: Mass Airflow (read; 0x11EF60: FFF88A4A x 0x753 >> 12, the same conversion as OBD PID 0x10 (0.01 g/s))

parameter.name: MAF Sensor Voltage
parameter.desc: MAF Sensor Voltage (inferred; 0x11F28C: FFF88A1A x 125 >> 15; volts if FFF88A1A = V x 13107)

parameter.name: Manifold Absolute Pressure
parameter.desc: Manifold Absolute Pressure (inferred; 0x11EEDC: FFF88A34 >> 8; kPa because index 0x24 is this minus barometric pressure + 128)

parameter.name: Manifold Relative Pressure
parameter.desc: Manifold Relative Pressure (read; 0x11E7FC: (FFF88A34 >> 8) - (FFF88E1E >> 8) + 128, clipped to 0...255; FFF88E1E is the OBD barometric source)

parameter.name: Barometric Pressure
parameter.desc: Barometric Pressure (read; 0x11E75C: FFF88668 (kPa x 256) >> 8)

parameter.name: Wastegate Duty
parameter.desc: Wastegate Duty (read; 0x11E910: FFF8B3B8 (WGDC, 25600 = 100 %) x 255/25600)

parameter.name: Commanded Throttle
parameter.desc: Commanded Throttle (read; 0x11F218: FFF8AF84 x 255/25600; FFF8AF84 is the OBD PID 0x4C (commanded throttle actuator) source, written by 0x0C326C in the torque model)

parameter.name: Battery Voltage
parameter.desc: Battery Voltage (inferred; 0x11F29C: FFF9DD61 x 125 >> 7; FFF9DD61 = V x 12.8 (inferred))

parameter.name: Vehicle Speed
parameter.desc: Vehicle Speed (inferred; 0x11F2B0: FFF99835 copied; the programming-session check 0x0AF014 refuses while FFF99835 > cal 0x579AA, i.e. a vehicle-speed check (inferred))

parameter.name: Knock Learning (DAM)
parameter.desc: Knock Learning (DAM) (inferred; FFF811AE pointed to directly; DAM x 16 (inferred, see Knock Correction Advance))

parameter.name: Throttle Position
parameter.desc: Throttle Position (read; 0x11E708: FFF8A346 (the OBD PID 0x11 source, 65535 = 100 %) x 125 >> 15 = % x 2.5)

parameter.name: FFF8A348 (Throttle Scale)
parameter.desc: FFF8A348 (Throttle Scale) (inferred; 0x11E718: FFF8A348 x 125 >> 15, same scale as Throttle Position; likely the second throttle signal (inferred))

parameter.name: FFF8A350 (Throttle Scale)
parameter.desc: FFF8A350 (Throttle Scale) (inferred; 0x11EF70: FFF8A350 x 125 >> 15; identity not decoded (pedal or throttle signal))

parameter.name: FFF8A352 (Throttle Scale)
parameter.desc: FFF8A352 (Throttle Scale) (inferred; 0x11EF80: FFF8A352 x 125 >> 15; identity not decoded)

parameter.name: Closed Loop Lambda (FFF8B2C2)
parameter.desc: Closed Loop Lambda (FFF8B2C2) (read; 0x11EDA4: (FFF8B2C2 << 15) / cal 0x38278 (43194 = lambda 1.0) - 32768, >> 8, + 128; written by the closed-loop routines 0x0FBAFC/0x0FC0CC, role (measured or target) not decoded)

parameter.name: Closed Loop Target (FFF8B312)
parameter.desc: Closed Loop Target (FFF8B312) (read; 0x11ED68: ((FFF8B312 >> 1) - 0x5587) x 0x3BDD >> 18 + 64, clipped; FFF8B312 is the closed-loop target in lambda x 43194 units (0x0FF634); the byte covers only lambda 0.96...1.17)

parameter.name: FFF8B2D8 (Fuel Correction)
parameter.desc: FFF8B2D8 (Fuel Correction) (inferred; 0x11ED58: FFF8B2D8 >> 8; FFF8B2D8 = 0x8000 when not running (0x0FBF58), so 128 = no correction (inferred))

parameter.name: Knock Raw (A791/A7A7)
parameter.desc: Knock Raw (A791/A7A7) (read; 0x11F1E4: (FFF8A791 x 19 + FFF8A7A7 (s8) x 19 + 0xD80) / 27; knock-module variables, meaning not decoded)

parameter.name: FFF8A7A7 (Knock Module)

parameter.name: AVCS FFF8B8EA

parameter.name: AVCS FFF8B8E4
parameter.desc: AVCS FFF8B8E4 (read; 0x11EE68: FFF8B8E4 x 0xD0E5 >> 19; AVCS module variable)

parameter.name: AVCS FFF8B8FA

parameter.name: Long-Term Fuel Trim (FFF811D9)
parameter.desc: Long-Term Fuel Trim (FFF811D9) (read; SSM byte = FFF811D9 >> 1 + 64 (0x11EC9C, read). FFF811D9 = learned cell + 0x80 (0x0FD3E4) is copied to FFF8A689 (0x0CECA8), and fuel is multiplied by (A689 + 128)/256 (0x0D15EC, read), so one count of 811D9 = 0.39 %; on the SSM byte, % = (x-128) x 100/128 (corrected 2026-10-30; it was shown double).)

parameter.name: Intake Cam Advance Bank 1 (FFF88DB0)
parameter.desc: Intake Cam Advance Bank 1 (FFF88DB0) (inferred; stock branch (cal 0x3CCC4 bit 0 = 1): learned rest FFF81582 - measured FFF88D8C, advance positive; cam edges later = larger (0x1D165A) (read, my research notes))

parameter.name: Intake Cam Advance Bank 2 (FFF88DB2)
parameter.desc: Intake Cam Advance Bank 2 (FFF88DB2) (inferred; stock branch (cal 0x3CCC4 bit 0 = 1): learned rest FFF81582 - measured FFF88D8C, advance positive; cam edges later = larger (0x1D165A) (read, my research notes))

parameter.name: Accelerator Pedal
parameter.desc: Accelerator Pedal (read; Index 0x029 points directly at FFF88A5E (2015/2016; FFF88DAE 2017, FFF88E3E 2018), the high byte of the u16 pedal value (65535 = 100 %) that feeds the Requested Torque maps (0x09E800 / 0x0BB588, read))

parameter.name: ETC Motor Drive
parameter.desc: ETC Motor Drive (inferred; Shadow FFF8A93A from FFF8A3B4 (x - 128, read); FFF8A3B4 is the electronic throttle motor drive of the servo loop (inferred, Phase 13))

parameter.name: A/F Sensor Lambda
parameter.desc: A/F Sensor Lambda (read; 0x11F040: FFF88AF8 >> 6, capped at 255; FFF88AF8 = measured lambda x 8192 from the front A/F sensor (0x06C1A8, read), the same variable OBD PIDs 0x24/0x34 report. Reads up to lambda 1.99; AFR assumes 14.7 stoich)

parameter.name: Calculated Engine Load (OBD)
parameter.desc: Calculated Engine Load (OBD) (read; 0x11EDE4 copies FFF886A2, which is also the OBD PID 0x04 source (0x171AC4 -> FFF8AB77, read); 255 = 100 %)

parameter.name: Injector Pulse Width (Injector 1)
parameter.desc: Injector Pulse Width (Injector 1) (inferred; 0x11F1C0: FFF8CF3C x 0x3333 >> 20 (= /80), capped at 255; FFF8CF3C = injector 1 pulse u32 >> 2 (0x1E5436, read). The pulse unit of 0.8 us is inferred (as logging-patch L24), so 0.256 ms per count; it saturates at about 65 ms)

parameter.name: Radiator Fan Duty
parameter.desc: Radiator Fan Duty (read; 0x11EFE0: FFF8B278 x 25 >> 14; FFF8B278 = radiator fan duty, 65535 = 100 % (0x0F7A88, read))

parameter.name: Purge Valve Duty
parameter.desc: Purge Valve Duty (read; 0x11E85C: FFF8A707 x 65 >> 6, the same conversion and source as OBD PID 0x2E, commanded evaporative purge (0x1715D0 -> FFF8AB6A, read))

parameter.name: Alternator Duty
parameter.desc: Alternator Duty (inferred; 0x11E88C: FFF8B718 x 0x7AE1 >> 19 (x 0.06); FFF8B718 = charging output command, 1667 = 100 % (read; alternator identity inferred))

parameter.name: EGR Valve Position
parameter.desc: EGR Valve Position (inferred; 0x11E9B0: FFF88A1C >> 1, capped at 255; FFF88A1C is the EGR valve position feedback, compared with 2 x the EGR command FFF8A81B for OBD PID 0x2D (0x1715F0, read); the step unit is inferred)

parameter.name: Intake OCV Current (Cam 1)
parameter.desc: Intake OCV Current (Cam 1) (inferred; 0x11EEB8: FFF88D70 x 625 >> 19; FFF88D70 x 2.5/65536 is the measured OCV current of the intake cam 1 AVCS current feedback (0x15ED58, read); amps inferred)

parameter.name: Intake OCV Current (Cam 2)
parameter.desc: Intake OCV Current (Cam 2) (inferred; 0x11EEA8: FFF88D72 x 625 >> 19; measured OCV current of intake cam 2 (0x15F158, read); amps inferred)

parameter.name: Exhaust OCV Current (Cam 1)

parameter.name: Exhaust OCV Current (Cam 2)

parameter.name: Brake Booster Pressure
